propositions: binding_lifecycle.py contains two below-seam ambient environment reads (RECONCILER_ABSENT_RETIRE_GRACE and os.environ.get via _env_int) that remain in LEGACY_EXCEPTIONS after RP-04 S7.3.a
The owned accessor resolve_absent_retire_grace() already exists in rebar._config_sources and is re-exported via the public rebar.config facade with identical semantics to the local _env_int shim

Replacing the _env_int call in note_absent with resolve_absent_retire_grace() imported from rebar.config eliminates the ambient read and the dead helper function while preserving absence-retire behavior
Removing both binding_lifecycle.py rows from LEGACY_EXCEPTIONS will reduce it to an empty list, completing the config-ownership drain
The _DEFAULT_ABSENT_RETIRE_GRACE constant must be retained despite the read removal because binding_store.py aliases it and tests depend on it
